description: Get median (p50) yearly total compensation in USD for each of ONE company's internal levels (e.g. Google L3/L4/L5, Meta E3/E4/E5) for a job family in one location, from submissions in the last 12 months. Call get-company-levels first to learn the company's level names. The company must have a known level structure. Free limit: Total compensation per level for one company and job family. No percentiles or counts. Pass canonical slugs (jobFamilySlug, locationSlug, countrySlug, companySlug): resolve names first with search-job-families, search-locations and search-companies; never guess a slug. REQUIRED arguments: jobFamilySlug, locationSlug, companySlug.

companySlug.description: A company slug, e.g. "google". Resolve it with search-companies first.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

locationSlug.description: One location slug (metro, state, country or region; not a city), e.g. "san-francisco-bay-area". Resolve it with search-locations first; for a city, use its parent metro.

name: get-salaries-by-company-level
